caption:
2 of us, 1 phone

2 of us, 1 phone. (my eyes drift) (and back)

People online are talking about a cheating rumor. The research is quieter.

The theory: across 8 studies, higher avoidant attachment went with more attention to attractive alternatives, more interest in meeting them and more infidelity over time, with lower commitment as the statistical link (DeWall, Lambert, Slotter, Pond, Deckman, Finkel, Luchies and Fincham, 2011, Journal of Personality and Social Psychology). A pattern in those studies, not a destiny and not a diagnosis.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A sage-green room with a small side table at the left holding a phone. Two small block figures with white eyes, an ink-black one on the left and a cobalt one on the right, look at each other and pulse softly, the cobalt one tilting its head. The phone lights up with rings and buzzes, and the black one's eyes go wide and drift to it while the cobalt one tilts its head toward it. Then the black one looks back, its eyes turn happy, both pulse together, and it leans a little toward the cobalt one. The text: 2 of us, 1 phone, my eyes drift, and back.
